undo.history.hint: Newest first. Undone operations are struck through; grayed ones can no longer be undone.
undo.blocked.title: Cannot undo
redo.blocked.title: Cannot redo
undo.blocked.published: it changed a remote, which an undo here would not change
undo.blocked.pruned: a fetch with prune cannot be undone; deleted remote branches come back with the next fetch
undo.blocked.pulled: a pull cannot be undone; reset the branch instead
undo.blocked.notRecorded: its previous state could not be recorded
undo.blocked.downloaded: it downloaded and checked out content (LFS files, submodule commits)
undo.blocked.filesDeleted: the worktree's local changes were deleted with it
undo.blocked.objectsMissing: what it needs was deleted by Git's garbage collection since
undo.blocked.unreadable: it was recorded by another version of yaggui
undo.diverged.title: Cannot undo: the repository changed since
redo.diverged.title: Cannot redo: the repository changed since
undo.diverged.description: Branches or files changed after this operation, in a terminal or by an action yaggui does not record. Undoing it would lose those changes, so nothing was touched.
undo.overwrite.title: Local changes are in the way
redo.overwrite.title: Local changes are in the way
undo.overwrite.description: Your local changes to the files below would be overwritten. Stash them, and the undo is retried right away; pop the stash afterwards to get them back.
